decisions.reason: The low-noise burner is a component of the firm's core infrared heater range, so it supports the established business, though the 2022 gas price shock is an aspiration shortfall that may prompt some search.
The plaque heater had its own page and sits in the firm's narrow core range, so dropping it would hurt the main business despite pressure on gas-fired heating.
The luminous radiant heater fits the established hall-heating portfolio and is likely still meeting aspirations in a growing industry, so it is kept, with some risk from the turn away from gas.
The multi-model tube heater line is a central revenue carrier for large halls, so the firm will keep it and adapt it rather than drop it.
The standard plaque heater overlaps with Product B, so it is the more likely candidate for consolidation, but it is still core business with limited reason to drop it now.
This tube heater may overlap with the D line and could be merged into it during problemistic search, but it is most likely kept as part of the core offer.
